question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4**' i.e. **'Born'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2 is** "born".**
 
• **In this context,** we're looking for a word that shows where Salvador Dali came into existence or started his life.
 
• The correct term for this is** "born".**
 
• The **sentence indicates** that Salvador Dali, the Spanish surrealist painter, was born in Figueres, Catalonia, on 11 May 1904.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: '*'Salvador Dali was a prominent Spanish surrealist painter **born **in Figueres, Catalonia, on 11 May 1904. Dali's father was strict in the education of his children unlike (3) ________ mother. Dali had a brother named Salvador (4) _______ was born nine months before him and died of gastroenteritis. When he was five. Dali was taken to his brother's grave and was told that he was his brother's (5) _______.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options don't fit:
 
 
• **"Rooted" **often refers to being established or fixed deeply and firmly, or having deep roots in a place or culture. However, it is not the appropriate word to denote someone's birth.
 
• **"Bought" **is the past tense of buy, which does not make sense in this context as you don't buy a person.
 
• **"Brought"** is the past tense of bring. It implies that someone was taken or moved from one place to another, which does not apply here as we're talking about the place of birth, not movement.
